result:
The build succeeds cleanly. All three missing operations are now implemented per the spec:

- **`ContainsPoint`** — scans intervals, returns true when `x` is in the half-open range `[starts[i], ends[i])`.
- **`ClipCovered`** — clamps each interval to `[lo, hi)` and sums the positive overlaps; carries the `lo <= hi` precondition and non-negative postcondition.
- **`GapCount`** — counts consecutive pairs with a strictly positive gap (`starts[i] > ends[i-1]`).

`TotalCovered` is unchanged, and each function preserves the existing conventions (`§Q` length-equality precondition, `§S (>= result 0)` where applicable, tilde-prefixed local bindings, indent-only blocks). The contract-verification pass (with Z3) accepted all postconditions, and the build reports 0 warnings / 0 errors.
